name: MapArc LMS
author: bobstanleygardner

sections.description:
MapArc LMS — Free, Full-Featured WordPress LMS

Free, full-featured, forever.

MapArc LMS is a WordPress learning management system for creating and managing structured online learning directly from your WordPress website.

Build courses with modules, lessons, and assessments. Enroll learners, track progress and completion, run self-paced or cohort-based programs, schedule drip learning, create multilingual course variants, and issue publicly verifiable certificates.

Designed for educators, training providers, nonprofits, organizations, and institutions, MapArc LMS brings the learning experience into WordPress — from course creation and learner management to assessment, progress tracking, and certification.

Your courses. Your learners. Your branding. Your WordPress LMS.

Build Structured Courses

Create courses with:

  • Modules
  • Lessons
  • Assessments

Organize content into clear learning paths using the MapArc LMS course builder inside WordPress.

Lessons can also include YouTube-hosted video content when required.

Manage Learners and Track Progress

Manage learners without moving your learning operations to a separate LMS platform.

MapArc LMS supports:

  • Learner registration and login
  • Course enrollment
  • Learner management
  • Lesson and assessment progress
  • Course completion tracking
  • Learner data export to CSV

Assessments and Certificates

Include assessments as part of the learner journey and use course completion as part of your certification workflow.

MapArc LMS supports configurable certificate completion rules and certificate signatories.

Signatories can include:

  • Name
  • Position
  • Affiliation
  • Optional signature image

Certificates can also be publicly verified, allowing third parties to confirm certificate information after a learner completes a course.

Self-Paced, Cohort, and Drip Learning

MapArc LMS supports both self-paced learning and scheduled cohorts.

Self-paced courses allow learners to work through available content according to their own schedule.

Scheduled cohorts can be used for training batches, workshops, educational programs, staff development, and other time-based learning programs.

Enrollment-relative drip scheduling can progressively release content according to when an individual learner enrolls.

Multilingual Learning

MapArc LMS supports multilingual variants for courses, lessons, and assessments.

Learner progress can remain shared across language variants, allowing translated content to remain part of the same learning journey.

Your Organization, Your Branding

MapArc LMS supports white-label institutional branding across the learner-facing experience.

Branding can follow your WordPress Site Identity or use custom LMS branding settings, helping the learning environment remain consistent with your website and organization.

Statistics, Privacy, and WordPress Integration

MapArc LMS includes public enrollment and completion statistics and allows administrators to export learner information to CSV.

It also integrates with WordPress personal-data export and erasure functionality and includes configurable certificate retention.

The core learning management functionality runs directly within WordPress and does not require a separate external LMS service.

Who Is MapArc LMS For?

MapArc LMS can be used by:

  • Training providers
  • Educational organizations
  • Nonprofits and NGOs
  • Professional associations
  • Independent educators and instructors
  • Skills-development programs
  • Community learning initiatives
  • Internal organizational training programs
  • Certification and professional development programs

Key Features

  • Courses, modules, lessons, and assessments
  • Dedicated WordPress course builder
  • YouTube lesson delivery
  • Learner registration and enrollment
  • Learner management
  • Lesson and assessment progress tracking
  • Course completion tracking
  • Certificate completion rules
  • Configurable certificate signatories
  • Optional certificate signature images
  • Public certificate verification
  • Self-paced courses
  • Scheduled cohorts
  • Enrollment-relative content drip
  • Multilingual course, lesson, and assessment variants
  • Shared progress across language variants
  • Public enrollment and completion statistics
  • Learner CSV export
  • White-label institutional branding
  • WordPress Site Identity integration
  • WordPress personal-data export and erasure integration
  • Configurable certificate retention

External Services

MapArc LMS provides its core learning management functionality within WordPress.

Course authors may optionally configure lessons to use content hosted by external services such as YouTube.

When external content is used, that content is subject to the terms, privacy policies, and data practices of the relevant external service.

YouTube Terms of Service:
https://www.youtube.com/t/terms

Google Privacy Policy:
https://policies.google.com/privacy

Privacy

MapArc LMS stores information required to provide learning management functionality, including learner enrollment, progress, assessment, completion, and certificate-related information.

MapArc LMS integrates with WordPress personal-data export and erasure tools.

Certificate retention can be configured according to the requirements of the website administrator.

Website administrators are responsible for configuring and operating their WordPress website in accordance with applicable privacy and data-protection requirements.
sections.installation:
1. Install MapArc LMS through the WordPress plugin installer, or upload the maparc-lms folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate MapArc LMS from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Follow the MapArc LMS setup process.
  4. Go to MapArc LMS → Add Course to create your first course.
  5. Add modules, lessons, and assessments.
  6. Configure learner registration and enrollment.
  7. Configure scheduling, certificates, signatories, and branding as required.
  8. Publish your course and begin enrolling learners.
sections.faq:
Is MapArc LMS free?

Yes. MapArc LMS is free and full-featured.

Does MapArc LMS require an external LMS platform?

No. The core learning management functionality runs inside WordPress and does not require a separate external LMS service.

Optional content selected by a course author, such as YouTube-hosted videos, may use the relevant third-party service.

Can I create courses with modules, lessons, and assessments?

Yes. MapArc LMS includes a dedicated course builder for creating structured courses with modules, lessons, and assessments.

Can I enroll learners and track their progress?

Yes. MapArc LMS supports learner registration, course enrollment, learner management, lesson and assessment progress, and course completion tracking.

Does MapArc LMS issue certificates?

Yes. MapArc LMS supports configurable certificate completion rules, certificate signatories, and public certificate verification.

Can I run self-paced and scheduled courses?

Yes. MapArc LMS supports self-paced learning as well as scheduled cohorts.

Can content be released gradually?

Yes. Enrollment-relative drip scheduling allows content availability to be based on when an individual learner enrolls.

Can I create multilingual courses?

Yes. MapArc LMS supports multilingual variants of courses, lessons, and assessments, with progress shared across language variants.

Can I use my organization’s branding?

Yes. MapArc LMS supports white-label institutional branding using your WordPress Site Identity or custom LMS branding settings.

Can I export learner information?

Yes. Learner information can be exported to CSV.

Does MapArc LMS integrate with WordPress privacy tools?

Yes. MapArc LMS integrates with WordPress personal-data export and erasure functionality and includes configurable certificate retention.

Can I use YouTube videos in lessons?

Yes. Course authors can optionally include YouTube-hosted video content in lessons.

Is MapArc LMS open source?

Yes. MapArc LMS is licensed under GPL-2.0-or-later.
